beliefs: The box reverses the order of characters in the input string [E1]
Whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, newlines) are removed from the output rather than preserved [E2]
After reversing, all whitespace is stripped, so 'a b' -> 'ba' and ' lead' -> 'dael' [E2]
Case, digits, and symbols are preserved as-is, only order changes and whitespace is dropped [E1, E2]
notes: E2 shows whitespace is removed entirely, not preserved. So the rule is: reverse the whole string, then delete all whitespace characters. This explains 'a b'->'ba', 'a  b'->'ba', 'a\tb'->'ba', ' lead'->'dael'.
